title: Acid–Base Neutralization
guideExplore: Drag the acid and base volume sliders, then press Pour/Play and watch the mixture's pH move toward (or away from) neutral.
guideEqualVolumes: Equal volumes of acid and base react completely — watch the pH settle right at 7 as salt and water form.
guideExcessAcid: More acid than base is poured — some acid is left over, so the final mixture stays acidic (pH below 7).
guideExcessBase: More base than acid is poured — some base is left over, so the final mixture stays basic (pH above 7).
conditionsHint: Sim speed changes how quickly the acid and base pour and react. Sliders set how much of each you pour.
learnMore: A strong acid and a strong base neutralize each other: Acid + Base → Salt + Water. Whichever reactant is left over after mixing decides if the final solution is acidic, neutral, or basic.
